title: Distribution-free false-alarm calibration and chance-corrected spatial evaluation for industrial anomaly detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.15090v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Studies of industrial visual inspection commonly report the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and the overlap between anomaly maps and defect masks. Neither measure specifies the false-alarm rate at a selected threshold, while recurrent defect locations and mask geometry can inflate overlap. We combine a distribution-free upper tolerance threshold with a paired-minus-crossed spatial test. This test compares each detector's score-contributing locations with the matched defect mask and with masks from other images; the difference in rates defines spatial-evidence lift relative to the empirical chance-overlap rate. We evaluate three detectors on 120 point-defect images from three ISP-AD modalities and three fixed data splits. Of 378 alarms, 230 overlap the matched mask. translated_title: 无分布假设的误报校准与工业异常检测的机遇校正空间评估
translated_abstract: 工业视觉检测研究通常报告接收者操作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）以及异常图与缺陷掩膜之间的重叠度。然而，这两种指标均未指定在选定阈值下的误报率，而重复出现的缺陷位置和掩膜几何形状可能夸大重叠度。我们结合了无分布假设的上容差阈值与配对减交叉空间检验。该检验将每个检测器的评分贡献位置与匹配的缺陷掩膜及其他图像中的掩膜进行比较；速率差异定义了相对于经验机遇重叠率的空间证据提升。我们在来自三种ISP-AD模态和三种固定数据分割的120张点缺陷图像上评估了三个检测器。在378个警报中，230个与匹配掩膜重叠。尽管如此，在九个检测器-模态组合中的八个，配对率和交叉率相似；仅DINOv2--ASM具有正的95%自助法下限。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合无分布上容差阈值和配对减交叉空间检验的新方法，用于工业异常检测中更准确地校准误报率并评估空间证据，避免掩膜几何和重复位置导致的评估偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a distribution-free tolerance threshold combined with a paired-minus-crossed spatial test to calibrate false alarms and evaluate spatial evidence in industrial anomaly detection, mitigating biases from mask geometry and recurrent locations.
